label: Mythical Creature
description: Legendary beasts with coherent anatomy. Tagged 'fantasy' so documentary templates exclude them.

items.name: mountain-dragon
items.text: an ancient mountain dragon half-merged with the crag, shale-plate scales lichened at the edges, wings furled like weathered rockfall, one slit pupil tracking movement below

items.name: phoenix
items.text: a phoenix mid-rebirth, inner wing feathers still molten orange, ash sloughing away with each wingbeat as embers spiral into new plumage

items.name: kitsune
items.text: a nine-tailed kitsune stepping between shrine gates, each tail tipped in pale foxfire, paws leaving no prints on the wet stone

items.name: griffin
items.text: a griffin mantling half-spread wings over its cliff eyrie, front talons gripping the ledge, tawny lion hindquarters coiled, wind combing its neck feathers

items.name: unicorn
items.text: a unicorn at a moonlit pool, spiral horn gathering starlight into a pale thread, breath silvering above the still water

items.name: kelpie
items.text: a kelpie surging from a black loch, mane and tail streaming back into falling water, hide slick as wet slate, the waterline refusing to break where it moves

items.name: thunderbird
items.text: a thunderbird riding the storm front on wings measured against the anvil cloud behind it, dry lightning webbing in its wake

items.name: forest-spirit-stag
items.text: a great forest-spirit stag with antlers of living branches in full leaf, moss saddling its back, the undergrowth bowing toward it as it passes

items.name: sea-serpent
items.text: a sea serpent's coils breaking a storm swell in glistening house-high arches, the body continuing down into darkness between them

items.name: baku
items.text: a gentle dream-eating baku, tapir-trunked and ember-eyed, elephant-grey hide over tiger-striped legs, drifting dream-mist curling into its nostrils

items.name: kirin
items.text: a kirin stepping across a stream without touching the water, antlered head bowed, opal scales rippling, small flames guttering at each hoof

items.name: roc
items.text: a roc passing over like weather, its running shadow swallowing the whole caravan valley, primary feathers the size of ship sails

items.name: wyvern
items.text: a wyvern climbing a sea cliff bat-fashion on wing-thumb claws and two hind legs, barbed tail hanging as a counterweight

items.name: pegasus
items.text: a pegasus banking through a canyon of cumulus, wings built like a condor's scaled up — a deep keel of flight muscle at the chest, slotted primary tips spilling turbulence — hooves tucked like landing gear

items.name: world-turtle
items.text: an island-sized world turtle surfacing in open ocean, whole jungles riding its barnacled shell, waterfalls draining off the rim of its carapace as it rises
